children: Mexico’s foreign minister Roberto Velasco Álvarez said the country wants security cooperation with the US to respect its sovereignty and territorial integrity, according to Bloomberg.

Speaking with Bloomberg This Weekend hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, he said Mexico remains cautiously optimistic about ongoing trade talks as it seeks relief from US tariffs on automobiles and steel.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Mexico Seeks US Cooperation Without Sacrificing Sovereignty
